lines.text: Micah tells the leaders of Jacob they hate good and love evil and tear the skin from God's people.
The leaders will cry out to the LORD, but He will not answer and will hide His face.
Prophets who lead the people astray proclaim peace while they chew, and for them the sun will set in daylight.

wrong_details.wrong: the sun will set in daylight, with the seers honored
wrong_details.true: night will come over them without visions, and the seers will be ashamed

lines.text: Micah is filled with power by the priests of the temple, and he says leaders build Zion with bloodshed.

wrong_details.wrong: by the priests of the temple
wrong_details.true: by the Spirit of the LORD

lines.text: Leaders judge for a bribe and priests teach for a price, so Zion will be plowed like a field.
